Volumes still exist (minio_data was removed? it printed "workspace_minio_data" - that's the output of docker volume rm error or success? It printed the name, meaning removed). Let me check. Actually the grep showed postgresql_data and qdrant_data but not minio_data, so minio_data removed. But minio's credentials were set with old password; since I'm changing the secret, minio volume must be wiped — done.

Wait, but there could be an issue: the mc alias uses `mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"`. The secret starting with `-` was interpreted as flag. Fixed now.

But also the minio server itself uses MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD. It started fine. Let me restart the stack.

Also note postgresql volume already created with old DB_PASSWORD which hasn't changed. Good. Let's bring it up again.
